answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using time-locked collateral deposits organized across a stepped fee terrace. Each new identity requires locking verifiable capital, imposing an escalating marginal delta of financial cost on mass identity generation and exposing zero-cost automation as a fable. While this binds identity count to scarce liquidity, it limits accessibility by pricing out resource-constrained micro-agents and fails against adversaries with massive balance sheets.
